title: Madras High Court: SBI Officers' Association Member's Removal Dispute Not Arbitrable Under Bye-Laws
case_name: G. Ganapathy v. State Bank of India Officers' Association & Ors.
card_summary: Justice K. Kumaresh Babu dismissed a former regional secretary's bid to stay his removal from the SBI Officers' Association's executive committee and membership through arbitration. The bye-laws, read narrowly, send to arbitration only disputes over their interpretation or matters on which they are silent, not a removal under the disciplinary clause. His remedy lay in an appeal to the General Body.
card_tip: Check whether a society or association's bye-laws actually send disciplinary removals to arbitration; a general referral clause aimed at interpretive disputes will not be read to cover expulsion decisions.
verification_notes: Confirmed from LiveLawBiz's report, which names the judge, case number and date, cross-checked against the judgment copy it hosts; both give the same bye-law clauses, the 28 July 2026 removal date and the basis for holding the dispute non-arbitrable.
